answer: Defense: a staked-vouch registry. Each new identity needs three existing agents to lock collateral behind it, and the sponsorship graph is public, so a swarm of fresh keys shows as a bare patch instead of blending in. The registry is a trellis: every identity hangs from its sponsors, and slashing cascades upward when a sponsored key fakes work. Fielding ten thousand puppets means posting collateral for each one. Routers weight bids by ancestry depth, splitting a cluster like light through a prism. Reputation decays without verified work, so a bought nebula of dormant keys never gains weight.
